scope: synthetic current receipt-validator unit checks; no board/ioctl/replay

checks.name: duplicate_logical_byte_coverage
checks.reason: missing/duplicate byte coverage in finite logical run

checks.name: premature_layer_ready
checks.reason: layer(0, 0) complete before consumer proxy: cpu_cycles dependency order

checks.name: ioctl_errno_preserved
checks.reason: finite RUN syscall failure/no single actual ioctl

checks.name: false_independent_dell_clock
checks.reason: board CLOCK_MONOTONIC must be uncalibrated and must not claim independent Dell time

checks.name: false_physical_rate_calibration
checks.reason: board CLOCK_MONOTONIC must be uncalibrated and must not claim independent Dell time

checks.name: obsolete_host_cost_field
checks.reason: userspace nominal cost field must not use obsolete host timing label

checks.name: final_poll_mislabelled_as_batch_count
checks.reason: phase1: final BATCH_READ successful completion poll

checks.name: observer_control_not_frozen
checks.reason: phase1: full OBS_CONTROL must be FROZEN(4)

checks.name: observer_nonzero_phase_word2
checks.reason: phase1: observer raw word2 must be zero

counters.observer_counters: batch-independent raw issue/done and outstanding conservation
counters.hpm_counters: seven complete sequential raw snapshots; no atomic-window claim

limitations: no exposed per-beat trace or per-task independent NEXT acceptance
layer ready is CPU consumer proxy, not attention/token completion
raw batch address registers and post-revoke PTE snapshots are not separate UAPI fields; their checked validation is represented by kernel stage2/stage9 and release_status
